title: Extending a dualizing complex along a polynomial ring stays dualizing
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that tensoring a dualizing complex over a Noetherian ring with the polynomial ring in one variable over it gives a dualizing complex over that polynomial ring (author lemma at source lines 3066-3071, label lemma-dualizing-polynomial-ring). The proof (source lines 3073-3087) checks the three defining properties of the extended complex: finite injective dimension through the corresponding statement for the extension of scalars, finiteness of the cohomology modules through flatness of the extension, and the duality quasi-isomorphism through flat base change of the internal hom (proof lines 3074-3086). The verification of the three properties is the substance. H3.
